status: The L2.2 spec: every drawn region names its word (`component`) or composition (`build`); the states home, arrival and report; the rest knob's states; Dock and arrival as events with the input hold; Home's focus as `order` and `nearestIn` data (lvgl-switch.md §2.6), each target group with its ring form (`ring`); the Incubator module's leaves as the `leaves` word, grid form
note: The one home of the Home numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Home, Dock and arrival) and its wireframes 01-home.svg to 01e-home-rest.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. What the layout document did not give was listed under `derived`; each entry is now the UI designer's decision, written into the document too. Idle is a state of the frame, in frame.json `idle`.

derived.colours: See `colours` and Home §4's colour roles. Bezel `metal`, lit `enamel`, shade `bevel`; glass edge `frostD`; the placeholder inside is a `forest` back and a `clay` ground band with a `sand` top row and a `soil` foot, the only warm field on screen; modules the kit's instrument panel with the word in `metal`, engraved and quiet; lamps off `hairline`, well `sprout`, waiting `sky`, needs you `amber`; the ribbon as on Pods; the report card an instrument `panel`, not paper
derived.rack pods: The signed 32×40 well pod, 1:1, at well + (4, 0). It fills the 40×40 well's height, so centred and bottom-aligned are one place: the stem on the well's top row, the shell's foot on its floor. The glint star is centred above its well, well + (14, -12)
derived.message plate: No plate. ← on the room does nothing and the bottom line shows no `← where`; a plate on Home would sit over the living window, which carries no words, and the top bar already names Home
derived.waiting lamp: UI designer, 2026-10-08: confirmed: at the resident box's top right, inset 0, so it stays off the creature's body; it rides the resident's 4 px lift; `sky` with a `void` rim
derived.offsets: derived, UI designer to confirm: where the document gives a region but not the place inside it: the crates sit 8 px in from the bay door's top left (crateAt); each row of leaves is 14 px under the one before (rowPitch); the Companion mark sits at (88, 16) on the bed (markAt), centred on the hollow; the ring under a resident is centred on its feet line, feet − 12 to feet + 12 (frame.json focus.ring.forms.feet); the focus starts from the middle of the stage (focus.roomAt) when nothing is focused — UI designer, 2026-10-09: confirmed, all five. The room's point is roomAt's centre (512, 300); nav.mjs homeMove's default (480, 280) is the build's and goes with it
derived.shield plates: Standing plates 16×32 on a 24 px pitch at (848 + 24i, 488), the tier's count (three on tier 1, four on tier 2, shields.perTier; count is the most), never a ghost plate; the report card's Probe row draws the same count of 16 px icons
derived.sleeping mibi: Each mibi with you, docked, is its resident painting in its nap pose in its stage's resident box, never the 48 px token: the first bottom-centred on the bed's hollow (544, 512) (adult 144×152 at 472, 360; juvenile 104×112 at 492, 400), the second 48 px to its left and the third 48 px to its right, drawn back to front so the first lies in front; each a focus target like a resident, no lift; the asleep mark at its box's top right (bed.sleeper)
derived.bay lift: 2 px, the chrome lift (frame.json focus.lift.chrome), over 200 ms as the door opens, held while the crates open, settling when the report card shows. At 4 the Bay's top would sit 4 px under the top bar's rule; the door, the beam and the crates carry the arrival. Nothing is scaled
derived.report card: `regions.report` and Home §5's table. Heading, one row per crate (pods pictured, the land's reach in words), Gathered (figures beside material icons only), the Probe's mend, the world's lines; 24 px rows, height 104 + 24 × (crates + Probe row) + (lines ? 40 + 24 × lines : 0), at most 312
derived.vocabulary: A module is a build of panel and the vivarium is a living window, both existing words; the rest knob, the with-you bed and the report card are compositions of panel and sprites, not new words (station-layouts.md, the vocabulary). The build names are `module`, `restKnob`, `withYouBed` and `reportCard`; the residents are the living window's `residents` part; the pods' travel during an arrival is the module build's `travel` part, drawn over the column
derived.ribbon wording: UI designer, 2026-10-08 (carried from the design-home-spec branch, b1db9879): the arrival ribbon without digits. Was "Expedition 4 home · 2 pods · explored 9 of 21" — copywriter, 2026-10-09 12:22: the crate only, "First crate home" (strings.ribbon), three words; the reach stays on the report card
derived.knob ring: The knob's focus box is 40×16 at (620, 540), centred on the knob as its 48×24 target is; its round ring, 4 px outside, is the 48×24 at (616, 534) with the 2 px lift, ending at y 558, 4 px clear of the bottom line's rule at 562. 4 px outside the 48×24 target it would end on that rule
derived.dock plate: UI designer, 2026-10-09: no message plate for Dock. The top bar's Companion returns (frame), the crates slide into the bay, and the notice names them. A plate on Home would sit over the living window (as for ←). A refused dock still shows its plate
derived.ink tops: art director, 2026-10-09 12:40: the dome's and the cradle's slices and their placeholders keep rows 0 to 3 empty; first ink at y 340 (dome) and y 468 (cradle). Written as domeInkTop and cradleInkTop beside the rects, which stay [x, y, w, h] arrays for the loader and the tests
derived.name tag: owner, 2026-10-07 (in force): the resident's name sits under it inside the living window on a tag; regions.nameTag. The bottom line's context then drops the name and names the species and stage (strings.residentSubject); the action keeps it ("✓ Look at Bean") (UI designer, 2026-10-09)
derived.bed master: The nest is a placeholder. The Home master paints the concept's shallow glass dish, about 160×80 at (566, 405), wide enough to hold one to three nap poses (sleeper.places, 48 px apart); when it lands, the bed's rect, the sleepers' feet and the Companion mark's place are re-measured from the master, for one, two and three sleepers (art director, 2026-10-09). Away, the bed keeps the Companion mark (Station screens, Home), not the absent mibi's silhouette
derived.module insets: art director, 2026-10-09 12:25: the Incubator's and the Probe's objects moved 8 px down, clear of their words: dome (704, 336), cradle (704, 464), sitting slot (952, 464), Shield plates (848 + 24i, 488); UI designer, 2026-10-09: leaves to (800, 352), and the Rack's wells and pods to y 224 with the glint star at y 212, 8 px clear of the word's baseline (204) as on the Bay. Were dome 328, cradle and slot 456, plates 480, leaves 344, wells 216, star 204
derived.away: UI designer, 2026-10-09: with the Companion away the Bay's door is shut and its lamp off; the Probe module shows its cradle empty and no plates (the Probe and its Shield are out with the Companion, whose HUD shows them); the bed shows the Companion mark. Docked, the door is open, crates or not

stateRule: home: the screen at rest, docked or away. arrival: from ✓ Open the bay until the last crate has opened (events.arrival), input held. report: from the arrival's end until the next press. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; the others exist in all three

resident.order: draw order of the residents, the bed and the sleeping mibi: by their feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the bed and its sleeper sort as one, at the bed's foot (y 528) (art director, 2026-10-09 12:40)
resident.arrival: the residents stop and face the column (right) until the report card shows
resident.props: per resident: mibi id, stage, painting or placeholder, waiting, seed; the face steps the walk

places.rule: the mibis with you in carried order: the first at the hollow's centre (foot, adult, juvenile as given), the second 48 px to its left, the third 48 px to its right; each place moves the foot and the boxes by its dx. Adult boxes 472, 424 and 520 (the third ends on the glass's edge, x 664); juvenile boxes 492, 444 and 540
places.draw: back to front: the third, the second, then the first, in front

sleeper.focus: each sleeper the feet ring, as a resident (focus.targets.resident)

states.docked: the nest, then the mibis with you asleep in it, one to three (sleeper.places)
states.away: the nest, then the Companion mark 16×24 at (536, 488)
states.none: the nest alone (no mibi with you)

composition: sprites: the mibis with you, or the Companion mark

nameTag.when: a resident (or the sleeping mibi) is focused; never otherwise
nameTag.w: the name's width + 16, rounded up to the 8 px grid, at least 48
nameTag.y: top at feet + 24, 12 px below the ring's ellipse (feet − 12 to feet + 12)
nameTag.flip: if its bottom would pass y 536, its bottom sits 8 px above the resident's box as drawn (lifted): top = box.y - 4 - 32; the sleeping mibi does not lift and its foot is 512, so its tag is always above: top = box.y - 32 (328 for the adult, 368 for the juvenile)
nameTag.inside: slid sideways to stay 8 px inside the glass (32 to 656)
nameTag.rule: The name is contextual, under the creature inside the living window on a tag, so it does not float; the chrome carries system information only

knob.drawnNote: the region stays 32×8 on the bezel's bottom rail (y 544 to 552); the knob is drawn 32×6, at rest at y 546 and lifted to 544, so it never covers the glass (rows up to 543) (art director, 2026-10-09 12:40; UI designer: confirmed, the ring stays 616, 534, 48, 24)
composition: sprite: knob on the living window's frame

beam.note: behind the opening crate, from the door's top to its foot: (712 + 96i, 84, 80, 72)

crateStates.sealed: the crate with its orange seal tag
crateStates.opening: the tag gone, the lid lifting (300 ms, events.arrival)

docked.lamp: needsYou while crates wait, else off
docked.crates: one sealed crate per consignment, at most three, left to right in the order they open

arrival.crates: opened ones open, the current one opening, the rest sealed

rack.arrival: a well whose pod is still travelling shows empty until the pod lands; a pod that finds no free well does not travel: it waits sealed and lands, oldest first, as a well frees (game designer, 2026-10-09 12:24)

leaves.status: both pictures are placeholders until their masters land: the Incubator's leaning leaf at 8×12, its empty outline `bevel` (create.json regions.leaves)
leaves.place: leaf i at (800 + 12 × (i mod 16), 352 + 14 × floor(i / 16)): rows at y 352, 366 and 380, the last ending at 392, the box's foot; 4 px between leaves, 2 px between rows
leaves.clear: the module word Incubator (Inter 16 at 704, 316, 72 px of ink to x 776, baseline 332): the first leaf row's ink starts at y 352 at the earliest, 20 px under the baseline, and at x 800, 24 px right of the word's ink; the dome (704 to 784) 16 px to the left; the lamp (984, 316) 24 px above the top row
leaves.count: one a minute the bud will take, up to 38 (create.json regions.leaves.count)

states.docked: the Probe in its cradle, its plates whole or gone
states.away: the cradle empty, no plates, the lamp off; the sitting slot still shows when a sitting is held (game designer, 2026-10-09 12:24: confirmed). The build draws a hairline ghost Probe (home.mjs drawCradle); the empty cradle replaces it

travel.path: a straight line, whole pixels, eased in and out
travel.note: the pods travel from the bay across the 8 px gap into the rack; nothing is scaled; a pod never leaves this rectangle

crateIn.when: the Companion docks with crates while Home shows, or Home is landed on from Idle by Dock; elsewhere the crates are simply in the bay when Home next shows

arrival.focus: the room; no ring; no key moves it

crate.do: the beam shows behind this crate; its seal tag breaks and the lid lifts (sealed → opening → open)
the ribbon shows this crate's words (it appears on the first crate and changes words on the next; a cut, no fade)
the counters tick this crate's materials (the top bar's own tick and flash)
each of the crate's pods travels to its well (regions.travel), in well order
the world turn jumps to the crate's turn (the top bar's tick)
the beam goes; the crate stays open and empty

probeMend.do: each mended plate seats, gone → whole, left to right

end.do: the ribbon goes, the crates go, the Bay settles (2 px, 200 ms), the residents walk again, the report card shows (state report)

steps.do: the knob settles from its lift; the ring goes
the screen transition (16-level Bayer dither) to Idle

focus.room: the ring on nothing: no ring is drawn, ✓ does what needs the player (the notice), the room's point is roomAt's centre (512, 300)
focus.rule: ◀ on a resident goes to the nearest resident to its left and ▶ crosses to the column: the edge is { nearestIn: resident, ahead: true }, as on the residents' ▲ ▼ (lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1), so two residents at one height are never stranded

primitives.spec: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 (architect, 2026-10-09 12:25): the edge forms, the order of a move and the integer scores on doubled centres govern; the lines below say the same in words
primitives.order: ▲ and ▼ step through the list as written, skipping ids that are not present; the ends stop, never a wrap; ◀ and ▶ take the group's own edges
primitives.nearestIn: the present target of that group with the least 400 × across + abs(along) on doubled centres: the row nearest the ring for ◀ ▶ (from the room, roomAt's centre); none: the ring stays
primitives.nearestIn ahead: only the group's present targets more than 6 px ahead in the key's direction (along > 12 on doubled centres), least 5 × along + 11 × across; none: the ring stays

focus.held: while events.arrival or events.rest holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent
focus.report: while the report card shows, a key closes it and also does what it does: the pad moves the ring by this graph, ✓ follows the bottom line, ← only closes

resident.box: the resident's box where the face has stepped it; each sleeper (bed.sleeper.places) is one, its adult or juvenile box moved by its place's dx, with no lift

knob.boxNote: the knob's target box as the restKnob build registers it, at rest; with the 2 px lift it is (620, 538, 40, 16) and the round ring 4 px outside it is regions.knob.states.focused.ring (616, 534, 48, 24), 4 px clear of the bottom line's rule at 562. Its centre (640, 548) is regions.knob.target's, so nearestIn scores are unchanged

vectors.from: a resident with others to its left
vectors.to: the nearest of them more than 6 px to its left, by along + 2.2 × across

vectors.note: three adults asleep and no resident awake: the second's box is 48 px to the left (ahead)
none ahead: the leftmost stays (fallback none)
the first is 48 px to the left, the second 96
▶ crosses to the column (nearestIn column): Probe's centre (848, 492) is the least across from the first's (544, 436); never another sleeper
the third (centre 592, 436) is the nearest resident to the knob
the column's order; the sleepers under and beside the knob are never reached by ▲

strings.bayClosed: closed while the Companion is away

ribbon.rule: the crate only; the reach stays on the report card (copywriter, 2026-10-09 12:22)
